collision energy: triggered for HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 30
enrichment method: Samp3ylated proteins were purified by $\alpha$-Flag chromatography
fractionation method: fractionated into 14 fractions by strong cation exchange chromatography (SCX)
instrument: a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) coupled to an RSLC system
labeling: labeled with iTRAQ (4plex Applications Kit, AB Sciex)
reduction concentration: reduced by addition of $\beta$-mercaptoethanol (2% (v/v) final concentration)
